gloss: left-side component of a kanji; radical

definitions.gloss: left-side component of a kanji character
definitions.explanation: The structural component that appears on the left side of a kanji character. One of the major categories of kanji components used to classify and look up characters in dictionaries.

examples.english: What is the left-side radical of this kanji?
The left-side component of the kanji for 'word' is the speech radical.

examples.japanese: {偏|へん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{旁|つくり}→旁：23626_tsukuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせる→組み合わせる：04659_kumiawaseru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When you combine a left component and a right component, you get a single kanji.

notes:
A term used in kanji study to refer to the left-side structural component of a character. In the traditional classification system, kanji components are categorized by their position within the character.

KANJI COMPONENT POSITIONS:
- {偏|へん}: left side (e.g., the {氵|さんずい} in ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧)
- ⟦{旁|つくり}→旁：23626_tsukuri⟧: right side (e.g., the {刂|りっとう} in ⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧)
- ⟦{冠|かんむり}→冠：03906_kanmuri⟧: top (e.g., the {宀|うかんむり} in ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧)
- ⟦{脚|あし}→脚：28733_ashi⟧: bottom (e.g., the {灬|れんが} in ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧)
- {構|かまえ}: enclosure (e.g., the {門|もんがまえ} in ⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧)
- {垂|たれ}: top-left wrap (e.g., the {广|まだれ} in ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧)
- {繞|にょう}: bottom-left wrap (e.g., the {辶|しんにょう} in ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧)

COMMON RADICALS CALLED {偏|へん}:
- {人偏|にんべん}: person
- {言偏|ごんべん}: speech
- {手偏|てへん}: hand
- {木偏|きへん}: tree
- {水偏|さんずい}: water
- {金偏|かねへん}: metal

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Not to be confused with ⟦{変|へん}→変：01124_hen⟧ (strange) or ⟦{辺|へん}→辺：00937_hen⟧ (area, vicinity), which have the same reading but completely different meanings.
